where: Tideglass Cavern & Gallery, the Sounding Cave on the coast road, and the Lanternway Under-Lane
mood: Buoy-light drift — a becalmed, glittering sea-cave; the coast road's tune reduced to a glint over dripping water.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
thin pulse-wave lead with a drifting melody in cavernous reverb
thin echoing pulse-wave lead with a drifting melody
bright bell and glass-chime figures like light glinting on cave water
soft brush stroke once per bar like a wave washing in
calm glittering sea-cave, becalmed and wondering, quietly magical

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet entrance into the cave: a few water-drip bell notes echo in the dark, a low bass root swells in, then the lead floats the first notes of the theme into the space}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the drifting melody: a simple hummable rising phrase spaced wide apart, each phrase answered by glinting bell sparkle, harp turning slowly underneath}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again with a soft flute counter-line and the glass chimes a little busier, like the walls catching more light}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: deeper into the cave, a turn to E minor, the lead held long and low over darker water, bells sparse and echoing, then the chimes rise back toward the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the drifting melody returns, calm and glittering; the last bar flows straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
